editorial:
Imagine getting your big break in the fashion world, only to have things go sideways in the weirdest way possible. You follow Cynthia, a hopeful model who finally catches the eye of the legendary designer Claudio. It starts off like a normal documentary about fame and beauty, but it quickly turns into a dark, twisted comedy. When Cynthia accidentally overdoses, the film crew doesn't call the police. Instead, they decide to keep filming her dead body to meet their deadlines. It is a wild, uncomfortable ride that mocks how the fashion industry values looks over actual human life.

The acting is great because it feels like a real documentary, making the creepy parts feel even more strange. You will love how the movie balances being funny and being totally gross at the same time. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the sheer boldness of the plot keeps you glued to the screen. If you like movies that make you say what on earth is happening, you need to see this. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, but if you want the best picture quality, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: In the end, the crew pushes the lie as far as they can, treating Cynthia like a prop for the camera. The twist is seeing how far the director and Claudio will go to protect their project and their reputations. Eventually, the truth comes out in a messy way, showing that everyone involved was more worried about the footage than the girl. It ends on a cold note, proving that the industry is heartless.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and movies that poke fun at high fashion.
